title: Demario Davis’ decision to come back home to Jets was ‘no brainer’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Demario Davis’ decision to come back home to Jets was ‘no brainer’
sources.description: The linebacker signed this week with the Jets, the team that drafted him in 2012 then traded for him in 2017. Davis returns as a 37-year-old and spent Thursday at the team’s Florham Park training center getting reacquainted.
